svg.title: mini casino wiring
svg.desc: breadboard view: uno, half size breadboard with buzzer and 330 ohm, oled lead in j2 to j5, rc522 and keypad wired straight to the uno
svg.text: hole by hole, the same jumpers and colours as in the 3d model
rows a–e top, f–j bottom, lower inner rail = gnd
the oled sits in the lid and reaches j2–j5 on a 4-wire lead. on the bench it plugs straight in.
